description: UK Power Networks Visual Amenity Projects is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction List of UK Power Network's Visual Amenity Projects where overhead power lines have been removed from National Landscapes and National Parks, restoring the British countryside to its beautiful best. Click here to view geographically and find out more about our Projects. Methodological Approach The Property and Consents team provided this dataset from their source. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Supporting Information. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
